name: SecretInput
description:
A write-only secret (BR notes): a stored value is never shown, only "Set", with Replace
and Clear. Replace swaps in an empty password box (with Keep current to back out); Clear
marks it for removal on save (with Undo). With nothing stored, the box takes a new value.
signature: ({ value, onValueChange, onBlur, width, disabled, invalid, name, id, placeholder }: SecretInputProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: id
props.description: A stable element or component identifier.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the control invalid. Pair it with an accessible validation message.

props.name: name
props.description: Names the secret for its buttons: "community" → "Replace community".

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called with the blur event of the password box or the action buttons; pass the form field's `handleBlur`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the whole next secret state when the person types, Replaces, Clears, keeps the current value or undoes; `stored` is passed through unchanged.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The prompt shown while the value is empty. It does not replace the field’s label.

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value. Keep it in application state and update it in the change callback.

props.name: width
props.description: Available width or named width tier.
